THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 Reference No.: KN/DS/PNY/AQ/WPP/PH-01/01. Min. Ref. No.: 4-3/11/2022/RE/276. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose: Description of the land or Servitude to be acquired: Allotments of land described below and depicted in Plan No. CM 920082, Situated in the Village of Vinasiodai belonged to Grama Niladhari Division of Gowtharimunai (KN/68) in Divisional Secretary's Division of Poonakary Kilinochchi District in Nothern Province. Lot No. 02 Name of the Land: Uyiladikadu; Description: Garden; Name of the Claimant: Not Known; Extent: 0.2199 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands/land on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Poonkary, on the 27th of May 2024 at 9.30 a.m. ested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 20th of May 2024 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. T. Akilan, Divisional Secretary, Divisional Secretariat, Poonakary. Divisional Secretariat, Poonakary. 17th April, 2024 EOG 04 - 0224/1
